svg.text: Combine: 500 bu | 1 semis x 1000 bu | GC arrival: 20 min | Return: 45 min | GC: 1000 bu/h
1 / Grain at field (bu): combine + on-site semis; no ground storage
2 / Semi grain loads (bu): load drops at GC arrival
4 / Grain center inventory (bu): batch arrivals, continuous processing
Dashed vertical line: harvest complete. Final deliveries and GC processing continue afterward.
